\section{モノイダル圏}

\begin{definition}
$\mathscr{C}$を圏とし$\otimes \colon \mathscr{C} \times \mathscr{C} \to \mathscr{C}$を共変関手とする.\
$\alpha \colon \otimes \circ (\otimes \circ \id_{\mathscr{C}}) \Rightarrow \otimes \circ (\id_{\mathscr{C}} \circ \otimes)$を自然同型とする.\
$I \in \Ob(\mathscr{C})$として$\lambda \colon I \otimes - \Rightarrow \id_{\mathscr{C}},\ \rho \colon - \otimes I \Rightarrow \id_{\mathscr{C}}$を自然同型とする.
次の2つの図式が可換になるとき組$(\mathscr{C}, \otimes, I, \lambda, \rho)$を\term{ものいだるけん}{モノイダル圏}{monoidal category}と呼ぶ.
% https://q.uiver.app/#
\[\begin{tikzcd}
	& {(A \otimes B) \otimes (C \otimes D)} & \\
	{((A \otimes B) \otimes C) \otimes D} && {A \otimes (B \otimes (C \otimes D))} \\
	{(A \otimes (B \otimes C)) \otimes D} && {A \otimes ((B \otimes C) \otimes D)}
	\arrow["{\alpha_{A, B, C \otimes D}}", from=1-2, to=2-3]
	\arrow["{\alpha_{A \otimes B, C, D}}", from=2-1, to=1-2]
	\arrow["{\alpha_{A, B, C} \otimes \mathrm{id}_D}", from=2-1, to=3-1]
	\arrow["{\alpha_{A, B \otimes C, D}}", from=3-1, to=3-3]
	\arrow["{\mathrm{id}_A \otimes \alpha_{B,C,D}}", from=3-3, to=2-3]
\end{tikzcd}\]
% https://q.uiver.app/#q=WzAsMyxbMCwwLCIoQSBcXG90aW1lcyBJKSBcXG90aW1lcyBCIl0sWzEsMCwiQSBcXG90aW1lcyAoSSBcXG90aW1lcyBCKSJdLFsxLDEsIkEgXFxvdGltZXMgQiJdLFswLDEsIlxcYWxwaGFfe0EsSSxCfSJdLFsxLDIsIlxcbWF0aHJte2lkfV9BIFxcb3RpbWVzIFxcbGFtYmRhX0IiXSxbMCwyLCJcXHJob19BIFxcb3RpbWVzIFxcbWF0aHJte2lkfV9CIiwyXV0=
\[\begin{tikzcd}
	{(A \otimes I) \otimes B} & {A \otimes (I \otimes B)} \\
	& {A \otimes B}
	\arrow["{\alpha_{A,I,B}}", from=1-1, to=1-2]
	\arrow["{\rho_A \otimes \mathrm{id}_B}"', from=1-1, to=2-2]
	\arrow["{\mathrm{id}_A \otimes \lambda_B}", from=1-2, to=2-2]
\end{tikzcd}\]
\end{definition}
